text: Whilst it's good fun to plan your attack the point of doing so is ruined somewhat by the randomness of the game. An entrance that can work twice in a row can fail on the third because the enemies suddenly kill you whereas previuosly they didn't. I'm assuming that this is because they have an element of randoness when they are generated or open fire. In other games this would be fair enough as it keeps the level from becoming too linear however in a game that tries to sell itself on the planning aspect it becomes pretty annoying quite quickly. You can edit the maps to remove the random enemy start points and play each one as a custom map but this means you don't get the progression of characters and equipment etc. that you would playing them normally. Maybe it's just me as I think the game would work much better if it were more like a puzzle game where your planning actually counted for more. I am still recommending it if picked up in a sale.

title: double action: boogaloo
text: Dustforce truly is a work of art. I don't mean that lightly. The way it's animated plus its music gives it that title in my book. I can find myself playing one level for an hour, maybe even hours at a time. The frustration of losing levels is filled with relaxation and calmness because of the ambient music. The way the levels are crafted is truly mindblowing. They had a system in which you had to perfect a level to earn a key, and you would use that key to earn more levels. In layman's terms, to earn more levels, you had to perfect current levels. They ditched that and added an XP system in which you gain more XP to earn a key the more levels you play and perfect. I'm very glad they added this system and was skeptical about buying it. But now that I did buy it, I do not regret it even for a second. One thing I really love about this game is how you don't have to unlock base levels. In a sense, this game is open world. That sense is that many levels are available to you, and you can choose whether you want to advance into more challenging levels, or stay where you're at. To get an S in completion, you have to sweep up EVERY leaf, and to get an S in Finesse, you have to maintain your combo throughout an entire level. Another thing I absolutely enjoy about Dustforce is its expasive community. There are lots of Community Workshop maps for you to sharpen your skills on, and lots of people who can set a good example. I'm sure most of the people who get best times on all the levels have a Youtube channel, so you can probably catch them there. The community may or not be active, but it sure is good and friendly. Overall, in terms of gameplay, music, artstyle, animation, and difficulty (it's not an easy game, but it's not that hard of a game either. It just depends on how much you want to play it), I rate this game: 10/10 BUY THIS GAME.

text: Play this game twice, then went to YouTube to see if i missed anything. Sadly not. The game is linear, witch is exactly what The Stanly Parable is not. there are no reaction to your actions. Not that you can do much else then the narrator wants you do. The whole point of The Stanly Parable is that you can choose to do as you wish and deal with the results. Here your actions have no meaning - the story will go on when you do what you told, not before and nothing else will provoke a responce. For example, the number pad - you don't have to hit any number (beside 9). You can hit any number and the result will be the same. For example, you can find the number #363 twice in the game, but dialing it does nothing. On the second playthrough - when i try to see if different actions will lead to a different ending - i found the tapes. They're basically everything that is not funny in Rick and Morty, with no humor or logic whatsoever. Go play The Stanly Parable demo. it's so much better and cost the same.

title: dragon age: origins
text: --AI is awful and I mean ....awful : They get stuck on every corner (and since most of the game is made of "block like" tiles like Neverwinter Nights, it means they get stuck everywhere). Your companions keep shooting at enemies even when their shots are "blocked". The game becomes a micromanagement hell, even more so since you cannot have it pause every turn by itself (Like lets say BG2), you cannot chain command your companions and even if you do manage to pause every 2 seconds and give them orders, you have to check them one by one to make sure they actually are able to do what you told them to do because 1/3 times, they will get stuck or will just stand there. --Combat is pathetic : Your party consists of only 4 members. That would be passable. even more so because of the bad AI, but you are always ...-always- pitted against 3-4 times that number. You may have your tank with its taunts, he simply cannot keep aggro of so many mobs by himself and survive no matter what you do. "Heal him then" would you say ....okay, that means out of my 4 members, 1 tanks (and doesnt do much damage), one heals the tank (so doesnt do damage). That leaves 2 members to be able to do damage. One will be busy trying to clear the mobs your tank aggroed. The other is at your discretion but lets not forget that while half the mobs are on your tank, the other "ranged" half is busy DPSing you from way out there. Unless you exploit the game's badly designed skills/magic or if you try to make "your own" char, and by that I mean a char you -think- will be great but isnt part of the game's almost forced mold, youll will have a hard time in every possible fights. --Magic is OP : If you read any forums or posts about the best class or best party, you will only see "make a mage" or "mages are the♥♥♥♥♥♥quot;. Why?, because they are. Forget about the level 1 weakling of BG1 with 6 HP and 1 magic missiles. People solo Dragon Age on Nightmare with mages. There is basically no casting time (except with a few selected spells), an unending supply or Lyrium potions (which are basically your typical Mana potion) and by the first half of the game, youll have the most powerful spells that can clear about every fight in 2 minutes. Lets not forget that that can be said for the enemy as well. So often, my "normal" party ran into a room with a mage simply waiting for me at the far back of it, simply to throw an instant fireball right in the middle of my group (since there no way to create some sort of formation), knocking them all down, burning them with DoT, making them lose half of their HP ...and that is without the "fighting tune" even starting. I then chug healing potions long enough for the same mage to throw a chain lightning right after ....and finishing with yet another fireball after a mere 10 secs later because ♥♥♥♥ you. --Lack of info on a lot of things : I equip supposedly an armor set (all chainmail I guess) I get an icon that says "Set item bonus" ....cool ....what is it?! ...theres nothing that explains to me what that bonus is. I have to google it...I alt-tab to do so, come back to the game...it crashes ...ah ok, its alt-tab incompatible. My weapon says "Weakens nearby Darkspawns"....cool...how do I know that it works? I see no visual effect, I see no status on any mobs at all. Does it work, I have no idea...Again, I google it but this time, I make sure I already quit the game (because its 2010 and they cant make games alt-tab compatible yet, its too high tech) and from what I read, they havent implemented the effect on game release. I have 3 activated (with upkeep) skill for my sword and board protagonist. Each one says about the same thing, being "Gives bonus against missile attacks" ...why do I have 3 of those, how great (or bad) is that bonus?! I dont see any numbers nowhere yet this is an RPG. --Skill tree is badly designed : I want a fireball spell ...why do I have to go through the whole damn line just to learn it? What do I care about Flaming Weapons or the "cone of fire" thing? ITs Fireball I want and I have to waste 3 skill points for it?! I want lethality for my rogue yet I need below the belt and Dirt Throwing before I can get it ...but I do -not- need those. Even worse, I cannot respec (Unless I have the DLC or use a mod). So what I think might be great early on becomes useless later on so Im stuck with those choices. I once made a build using Morrigan that was based on Sleep/Horror kind of spells. It worked very well early where the Darkspawn are weaker but I noticed at about mid-game that the combo I was doing wasnt working anymore because the Darkspawn became more and more powerful and thus resisted my attempts to put them to sleep making my mage simply useless with no way to change that. --Minor but still find it annoying : When even in BG2, you could make your mage awesome looking with its Robe of the Archmage and Staff of Power, I find it hard to believe that in a game from Bioware, with 3D visuals, Overpowered mages, they couldnt come up with better looking gear for mages. They simply look like giant♥♥♥♥♥♥♥with their robes and hats, their staffs looking like twigs picked up from a cow's behind. --Camera is too limiting : I remember reading that you could play the game as a "3rd person" kind of game or go back to the original "overview" type especially in battle to facilitate giving orders and seeing the battlefield. That would have been great if the camera wasnt stuck around your char. You cannot scroll too far away from your party and that gets really annoying when youre trying to play "ala" BG2. I tried to finish Dragon Age Origins about 15 times. Again, this week, I tried sicne I saw the game for 7$, it reminded me that I had it and never finished it. And everytime I retry, everytime I go through the prologue, then to lothering and see the first few battles that pits you against 3 times your number, even at level 3, with no skills and no gear, I just feel like throwing this piece of crap in the junk. Yet I continue, thinking that if I keep going, my party is going to be stronger, with better gear and itll become fun instead of tedious ...and everytime, its the same thing over and over again. I refuse to go by the "book", to go the way the game seem to force me to go, by making me create a type of party, with certain skills that are mandatory and with certain spells that are also mandatory and if I do not comply to this, I either have the most difficult time advancing (even on normal) or I just give up because it becomes as boring, tedious as a fulltime job.

text: Now you are scrolling down the reviews and have seen that I do not recommend this game. DON'T GET ME WRONG I LOVE THIS GAME!!!! There is just one problem........Windows 10. Must I say more. This game has issues running on Windows 10. I have a long history with playing this game on the Playstation and enjoyed every long hours of it. Then I saw it on sale and bough it immediatly hoping to enjoy it on my PC. I didn't have any problems installing it. Heck it ran perfectly......for a time. For those who are unfamiliar with the game some background is in order. In the beginning of the game when you create your character you can select a race, class, and background, much like most fatasy games. These decisions influence which prologue you start out in the beginning of the game. Then all the prologues meet up with the Grey Wardens and you progress to the main plotline of the game. What happened to me was I installed the game and it ran perfectly. Creating a character and playing was okay too. However I would get about 30mins into the game(reaching the end of the prologue) and the game would crash. At first I though it was a little bug and decided to make another character with a different prologue. At the exact same time in the different prologue it crashed about 30mins in (at the end of the prologue). Literally nothing I did solved this problem. Tried unistalling and reinstalling. Tried running offline. Tried searching the internet, but nobody had a solution to solve this problem. The only other problems I found that others had was either installing it or actually running it and I have never had that problem. So I there is two reasons for this review 1. To warn you that if you are a Windows 10 user to purchase with caution 2. If anyone else has had this problem and has found a solution to tell me because I LOVE this game and want nothing more then to actually run it ;)
